S1_positive_cluster.description: 4 cattle FMD reports in satellite hamlets of Rasipuram, all within 4km of each other (well under 5km) and within a 3-day span (well under 7 days).

S2_negative_only_3_cases.description: 3 goat PPR reports, same tight hamlets, same week -- one short of the 4-case minimum.

S3_negative_too_far_apart.description: 4 cattle FMD reports, same week, but each in a different corner of the district (min pairwise distance ~9km) -- exceeds the 5km spatial threshold.

S4_negative_outside_time_window.description: 4 cattle FMD reports, same tight hamlets (<=4km apart), but spread across 19 days -- exceeds the 7-day window in total spread.

S5_negative_different_top_disease.description: 4 reports in the same tight hamlets, same week, but each animal's top-ranked disease differs (FMD, Mastitis, PPR, Blackleg) -- same-disease grouping never reaches 4.
S5_negative_different_top_disease.expected_result: NO CLUSTER (no shared top-ranked disease across >=4 reports)

S6_boundary_near_miss.description: 3 cattle FMD reports tightly clustered (~1.7km apart, same day) that would need a 4th to trigger -- the 4th same-disease, same-week report is placed 4.6-7.1km away, just outside the 5km threshold.
S6_boundary_near_miss.expected_result: NO CLUSTER (3 in-range reports is one below minimum; 4th report is out of spatial range)
